jobs.title: Accounting Specialist
jobs.description:
The purpose of Idorsia is to discover, develop and commercialize innovative medicines to help more patients. To achieve this, we will develop Idorsia into a leading biopharmaceutical company, with a strong scientific core.

Make an impact in a collaborative international finance team.

We're looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Accounting Specialist to join our Finance team. In this role, you'll help ensure the smooth running of our day-to-day financial operations while contributing to accurate financial reporting and the continuous digitalization and automation of finance processes, helping to improve efficiency, data quality, and the overall user experience.

Working closely with colleagues across the business, you'll play an important role in accounts payable, general accounting, month-end closing activities, and finance projects in an international environment.

Your responsibilities

• Process vendor invoices accurately and in compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.

• Review and process employee expense claims and payment requests.

• Prepare payment runs and perform bank postings and reconciliations.

• Maintain accounts payable subledgers and resolve posting discrepancies.

• Respond to vendor and internal stakeholder inquiries regarding invoices, payments, and account balances.

• Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities, including audits and VAT reporting.

• Contribute to ERP enhancements and finance process improvement initiatives.

• Provide support across the Finance team on additional accounting activities as required.

What you'll bring

• Commercial apprenticeship or equivalent qualification with accounting experience.

• Further education or a degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field is an advantage.

• Fluent in English, both written and spoken; German and/or French are an asset

• At least five years of experience in a similar accounting role, ideally within an international company.

• Sound understanding of accounting principles and accounts payable processes.

• Experience working with ERP systems and Microsoft Excel.

• A structured, reliable, and detail-oriented working style with a continuous improvement mindset.

• Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to working with colleagues and external partners.

Why join us?

• Be part of an international and collaborative Finance team.

• Take ownership of diverse accounting responsibilities with real business impact.

• Help shape the digital transformation of Finance by contributing to automation and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Grow your expertise in a dynamic and supportive environment.

Work  Location: Allschwil, Switzerland

Business Area: Global Finance & Procurement

Schedule: Fulltime

Job Type: Permanent

Job ID : 4795

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about patient safety and ensuring that medicines are monitored to the highest standards? As a Drug Safety Case Manager, you will play a critical role in safeguarding patients by ensuring accurate and timely management of safety information throughout the product lifecycle.

Working within a collaborative and highly skilled Drug Safety team, you will take ownership of adverse event case management activities while partnering closely with physicians, clinical teams, regulatory colleagues, and external partners to ensure compliance with global pharmacovigilance requirements.

Your Responsibilities:

Case Management & Safety Reporting

• Manage adverse event cases from receipt through submission, including triage, data entry, medical coding, narrative writing, quality review, and expedited reporting for both clinical trial and post-marketing cases

• Prioritize and process safety cases in accordance with global regulations, SOPs, and reporting timelines

• Identify missing or incomplete information and coordinate follow-up activities with Drug Safety Physicians and other stakeholders

• Monitor case workflows to ensure efficient and compliant case processing

• Support or oversee reconciliation activities to ensure data consistency across systems

Clinical Trial & Cross-Functional Support

• Contribute to the successful set-up of new clinical studies by providing safety reporting documentation, reconciliation plans, monitoring guidance, and TMF documentation

• Support SAE reconciliation activities between clinical and safety databases

• Coordinate SUSAR notifications to investigators and Ethics Committees

• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including CROs, to establish and maintain safety agreements and processes

What You'll Bring:

• Degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, or a related healthcare discipline

• Minimum 5 years of experience in drug safety case management

• Strong understanding of medical terminology, disease processes, and safety databases

• Experience with medical coding dictionaries and safety reporting systems

• Good knowledge of EU and US pharmacovigilance regulations and reporting requirements

• Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines

• Strong attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and a collaborative mindset

• Fluent English, both written and spoken

• EU/EFTA citizenship is required due to permit restrictions

Why Join Us?

This role offers the opportunity to make a direct impact on patient safety while working in a dynamic, international environment. You will collaborate with experienced professionals across clinical development and pharmacovigilance, contribute to innovative clinical programs, and play a key role in ensuring the safe use of medicines.

• Identify missing or incomplete information and coordinate follow-up activities with Drug Safety Physicians and other stakeholders

• Monitor case workflows to ensure efficient and compliant case processing

• Support or oversee reconciliation activities to ensure data consistency across systems

• Contribute to the successful set-up of new clinical studies by providing safety reporting documentation, reconciliation plans, monitoring guidance, and TMF documentation

• Support SAE reconciliation activities between clinical and safety databases

• Coordinate SUSAR notifications to investigators and Ethics Committees

• Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including CROs, to establish and maintain safety agreements and processes

jobs.description:
About Idorsia Pharmaceuticals Ltd

Headquartered near Basel, Switzerland – a European biotech hub – Idorsia has a highly experienced team of dedicated professionals, covering all disciplines from bench to bedside; QUVIVIQ™ (daridorexant), a different kind of insomnia treatment with the potential to revolutionize this mounting public health concern; strong partners to maximize the value of our portfolio; a promising in-house development pipeline; and a specialized drug discovery engine focused on small-molecule drugs that can change the treatment paradigm for many patients.

We are looking for the Head of Global Supply Chain to join our company !

Job Responsibilities

The  Head of Global Supply Chain leads the design and execution of an end-to-end global supply chain across Development, Manufacturing, and Commercial Operations.

The role oversees planning (IBP/S&OP), external manufacturing and sourcing, logistics and distribution, and master data, ensuring a scalable, agile, and compliant supply chain.

Working cross-functionally, the VP drives forecasting, supports product launches, optimizes financial flows, and builds a high-performing team, combining strategic leadership with hands-on execution in a dynamic environment.

• Design, implement, and lead an end-to-end Global Supply Chain organization , covering planning, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, and distribution.

• Define and execute a scalable, agile, and digital supply chain strategy supporting both product launches and long-term growth.

• Establish and lead Integrated Business Planning (IBP) / Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) processes to align demand, supply, and financial plans.

• Develop and implement best-in-class forecasting models and systems , ensuring accuracy and alignment with commercial and R&D pipelines.

• Oversee external manufacturing and sourcing activities (drug substance and drug product), ensuring supply reliability, quality, and cost efficiency.

• Design and optimize global logistics and distribution networks across US, EU, and Asia, including warehousing and transportation strategies.

• Define and manage country-specific distribution models and select/oversee third-party partners (CMOs, wholesalers, logistics providers).

• Ensure full GDP compliance and adherence to all applicable regulatory and quality standards across the supply chain.

• Build, lead, and develop a high-performing global supply chain team , fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

• Drive operational excellence initiatives , including process standardization, lean practices, and performance management.

• Lead new product introduction (NPI) supply readiness in close collaboration with R&D, Regulatory, and Commercial teams.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Commercial, Finance, Tax, HR, Market Access, and R&D to ensure alignment on forecasts, supply plans, and financial flows.

• Manage key relationships with external partners and stakeholders , including CMOs, distributors, and governmental bodies.

• Own and manage the Global Supply Chain budget , including planning, sourcing, logistics, and operational costs.

• Monitor market demand and supply performance , analyze trends, and adjust supply plans accordingly to ensure product availability.

• Lead transformation and change management initiatives within a dynamic and evolving global environment.

•
 Bachelor’s, Master’s, or MBA in Economics, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or related field

•
 Fluent in English; French and/or German is an asset

•
 Minimum 15+ years of experience in Supply Chain management, ideally within the Life Sciences / Pharmaceutical industry

•
 Experience across primary care and specialty care supply chains, including external manufacturing models (CMOs)

•
 Proven experience supporting product launches and/or development phases

•
 Strong track record in building and leading supply chain teams at regional or global level

•
 Experience in both large, best-in-class organizations and scaling supply chain functions in smaller or growing environments

•
 Strong exposure to pan-European supply chains; experience in North America and Asia is a plus

•
 Solid knowledge of manufacturing processes and GxP (GMP & GDP) requirements

•
 Good understanding of regulatory frameworks, including launches, tech transfers, and supplier qualification

•

We are seeking an experienced, entrepreneurial Senior Clinical Pharmacologist to join our organization. This is a hands-on, high-impact role within Global Clinical Development, offering significant visibility and growth potential in the organization, and requiring close collaboration with Translational Research.

• Lead the design and execution of clinical pharmacology strategies and corresponding studies across multiple programs,

• Develop innovative and meaningful clinical pharmacology approaches that accelerate and de-risk drug development

• Define dose selection, escalation strategies, and characterize exposure-response relationships

• Ensure integration of nonclinical, translational, biomarker and clinical data to inform development decisions

• Design clinical studies with appropriate pharmacokinetic (PK) and pharmacodynamic (PD) endpoints

• Apply biomarkers and model-informed drug development (MIDD) approaches to enhance study design and decision-making

• Author and contribute to protocol development, including statistical and modeling/simulation considerations

• Serve as the primary clinical pharmacology interface with: Research, Translational Sciences, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs

• Represent clinical pharmacology at life cycle meetings

• Lead scientific discussions and provide strategic input in program governance meetings and decision-making forums

• Manage a large inflow of new clinical candidates alongside ongoing studies

• Author and contribute to regulatory documentation (IND/CTA, briefing documents, health authority responses)

• Represent clinical pharmacology in agency interactions as a subject matter expert

• Manage and oversee external partners (CROs, modeling vendors)

Qualifications & Experience

• PhD, PharmD, MD, or equivalent in Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacokinetics, or related field

• 10+ years of job relevant industry experience in biotech/pharma

• Proven track record in:

• Early clinical development (FIH through proof-of-concept)

• Study design and dose justification

• PK/PD modeling and interpretation

• Experience managing multiple concurrent programs in a dynamic environment

• Entrepreneurial mindset and intellectual curiosity with ability to thrive in ambiguity and rapid change

• Strong scientific leadership with a hands-on, execution-oriented approach

• Demonstrated ability to translate clinical pharmacology data into high-quality manuscripts, abstracts, and conference presentations

• Excellent cross-functional collaboration and influencing skills

• Ability to balance strategic thinking with operational delivery

Why Join Us?

• Join a science-led organization with a proven track record of innovative medicines from discovery to launch

• Opportunity to work on multiple innovative early-stage programs with a high level of ownership and visibility across the organization

About Idorsia Pharmaceuticals Ltd

Headquartered near Basel, Switzerland – a European biotech hub – Idorsia has a highly experienced team of dedicated professionals, covering all disciplines from bench to bedside; QUVIVIQ™ (daridorexant), a different kind of insomnia treatment with the potential to revolutionize this mounting public health concern; strong partners to maximize the value of our portfolio; a promising in-house development pipeline; and a specialized drug discovery engine focused on small-molecule drugs that can change the treatment paradigm for many patients.

We are looking for a VP, Head of Global Marketing to join the company!

Job Responsibilities

The VP, Head of Global Marketing is a senior strategic leadership role responsible for defining and driving the global commercial strategy of pipeline and launch assets from Phase 2 onwards.

The role serves as the global commercial voice across the product lifecycle, ensuring that clinical development, evidence generation, market access, medical strategy, positioning, launch readiness, and lifecycle planning are fully integrated to maximize asset and portfolio value.

Working cross-functionally with Development, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Finance, Regions, and Commercial teams, the VP, Head of Global Marketing leads New Product Planning, Launch Readiness, and Global Launch Excellence while supporting executive decision-making and long-term value creation.

• Lead New Product Planning (NPP) activities across pipeline assets from Phase 2 onward.

• Define and execute global commercial strategies for development-stage and launch assets.

• Partner with Life Cycle Leaders to shape asset strategy, target indications, sequencing, evidence generation plans, and lifecycle opportunities.

• Develop asset value propositions, differentiation strategies, target product profiles, and commercial business cases.

• Assess market opportunities, competitive landscapes, patient needs, treatment pathways, and future standards of care.

• Provide commercial input into clinical development plans to ensure future market adoption, reimbursement, and differentiation.

• Build commercial forecasts, opportunity assessments, valuation scenarios, and portfolio recommendations.

• Establish and lead the global Launch Readiness framework, governance, milestones, and decision-making processes.

• Drive integrated launch planning across Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Finance, Regions, and Affiliates.

• Identify launch-critical risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans to ensure successful execution.

• Define and monitor launch readiness metrics, dashboards, scorecards, and performance indicators.

• Serve as Global Launch Lead for selected strategic assets from late-stage development through launch and early commercialization.

• Lead global cross-functional launch teams and coordinate launch execution across all key functions and regions.

• Develop global brand strategies, positioning, segmentation, messaging architecture, and stakeholder engagement plans.

• Translate clinical differentiation into compelling value propositions for healthcare professionals, patients, payers, and health systems.

• Partner closely with Medical Affairs and Market Access teams on scientific platforms, evidence strategies, pricing assumptions, and reimbursement plans.

• Collaborate with regional and affiliate teams to ensure globally aligned but locally adaptable launch and commercialization strategies.

• Support portfolio prioritization, launch sequencing, resource allocation, and investment decisions across the organization.

• Develop frameworks for portfolio assessment, asset prioritization, and strategic trade-off analyses.

• Prepare executive-level strategic recommendations, governance materials, launch updates, and decision-support documentation.

• Establish governance and operating rhythms for Global Marketing, New Product Planning, and Launch Readiness activities.

• Drive alignment between Development, Medical, Access, Commercial, and Regional organizations to ensure integrated asset strategies.

• Lead post-launch reviews, performance tracking, and lifecycle optimization initiatives.

• Build a culture of accountability, strategic thinking, execution excellence, and cross-functional collaboration.

Candidate's Requirements

• Advanced degree in Business, Life Sciences, Medicine, Pharmacy, or related field preferred.MBA, PharmD, MD, PhD, or equivalent experience considered an advantage.

• Minimum 15+ years of experience within Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or Healthcare.

• Significant experience in Global Marketing, New Product Planning, Commercial Strategy, Launch Excellence, or Lifecycle Management.

• Proven track record of leading global and/or regional product launches.

• Strong experience supporting assets from Phase 2 clinical development through commercialization.

• Deep understanding of asset strategy, target product profile development, evidence generation, market access, indication sequencing, and lifecycle planning.

• Experience working closely with Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Market Access, and Regional Commercial organizations.

• Excellent communication, presentation, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills.

The purpose of Idorsia is to discover, develop, and commercialize innovative medicines to help more patients.

Headquartered in Switzerland – a biotech-hub of Europe – Idorsia is a high-potential biopharmaceutical company, specialized in the discovery, development and commercialization of innovative small molecules, with the aim of transforming the horizon of therapeutic options.

We are looking for a  Technical Project Leader – Drug Substance to join our Drug Substance and Sourcing Strategy team to lead the development of new chemical entities with a focus on Drug Substance matters. Idorsia is currently running development programs for numerous products at all clinical phases (I, II & III) as well as managing commercial assets.

Job Responsibilities

• The Technical Project Leader Drug Substance will lead the technical development of several drug substances, from early phase to late phase development activities up to commercial and/or product discontinuation.
Main responsibilities are as follows:

• Lead and manage development, analysis, and production of drug substance for the assigned projects for clinical and / or market supplies

• Lead manufacturing and scale-up activities toward API including supplies of building blocks, Regulatory starting materials or GMP intermediates

• Leads technical transfer for drug substance processes and the definition of CPPs and CMAs for drug substances

• Lead the technical drug substance development activities (in house or external): plan, organize and administer the different aspects of the technical activities required for development, scale-up, validation and manufacturing of a drug from development up to commercial supplies

• Lead the collaboration with external development partners with special emphasis on cost efficiency, timelines and scientific quality

• Works collaboratively with Drug Product Technical Project Leader(s) to address any physico-chemical requirements for the DS

• Develop and execute risk mitigation plans for drug substance supplies

• Ensure compliance with regulatory guidelines and adapting to and implementation of new regulatory initiatives (e.g. nitrosamines risk assessment) at Idorsia

• Upon project needs at the discretion of the Head of DSDM, assume whole or partial responsibilities and tasks of API safety project leader

Candidate's Requirement

• Chemist, Chemical engineer or equivalent with Master or PhD (preferred) with minimum 5 years of relevant experience in the pharmaceutical industry

• Minimum of 2 years of leading of an interdisciplinary drug product team

• Scientific expertise in Drug Substance development and / or Manufacturing

• Experience in setting development and regulatory drug substances strategies for products in development

• Profound knowledge of GMP, quality control and pharmaceutical development and/or production processes, based on current guidelines

• Profound knowledge in QbD, DOE and QRM

• Ability to negotiate, plan, and coordinate technical development and manufacturing activities

• Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to adapt effectively to rapidly changing organization issues, structures and dynamics

• Excellent English required (oral and written)

Work Location : Basel Area

Country : Switzerland

Business Area: Technical Operations - Drug Substance and Sourcing Strategy

Schedule: Fulltime

Job Type: Permanent

We are looking for a HR Services  Specialist to join our HR Services team !

The main focus of this role is to ensure timely and accurate administration of HR processes/operations, to support employees and HR Business Partners, and to provide information regarding administrative questions related to contracts, time & absence management, employment administration, etc. for our European and International Markets.

Job Responsibilities

• First level support to employees regarding HR administrative questions including time & absence management questions

• Administration of the employee life-cycle: onboarding - employee transfers – exit

• Issue employment contracts, contract amendments as well as other contractual documents based on input of HR Business Partners and/or Directors

• Ensure all necessary work permits are requested on time and liaise with the corresponding authorities

• Issue employment confirmations and other certificates to employees

• Issue interim and final reference letters to employees based on input of HR Business Partners/Directors and/or Line Managers

• Administer all employee data in the relevant HR systems and ensure its accuracy and high standard quality

• Manage scanning and filing of all relevant HR Documents in the Digital Dossier (E-Archiving) system

• Interface with HR Business Partners/Directors, payroll and other internal stakeholders

• Administer time & absence management system and take action in consultation with the employee and/or line manager

• Build and enhance relationships / network across Idorsia at various levels

• Participate or lead in smaller projects across the HR Services team

• Continuously focus on and support to implement business improvement efficiencies across the HR Services team, and help the team to reduce complexities in all related HR processes

• Supporting function in the monthly payroll

Candidate’s Requirements

• Apprenticeship in administration (KV) and a further education in Human Resources Management (e.g. “Eidg. Dipl. Personalfachmann/-frau” or equivalent)

• Minimum 4 years of experience in HR Administration in a multinational environment

• Applied knowledge of European Labor Law, social insurance and tax system and regulations is a plus

• Computer and software usage literate

• Strong customer service orientation

• Proven effective communication skills

• Effective team player

• Detail oriented & exact, efficient working

• Ability to set priorities and manage several tasks at a time

• Fluency in  English (written & spoken) and any other European Language is a plus

Nous cherchons un spécialiste des services RH pour rejoindre notre équipe des services RH ! Ce rôle vise principalement à assurer une administration opportune et précise des processus/opérations des RH, à soutenir les employés et les partenaires des RH, et à fournir des informations sur les questions administratives liées aux contrats, à la gestion du temps et de l'absence, à l'administration de l'emploi, etc. pour nos marchés européens et internationaux. Responsabilités professionnelles
• Soutien de premier niveau aux employés concernant les questions administratives des RH, y compris les questions de gestion du temps et de l'absence
• Administration du cycle de vie des employés : à bord - transferts des employés – sortie
• Émettre des contrats de travail, des modifications de contrats ainsi que d'autres documents contractuels fondés sur les commentaires des partenaires d'affaires des RH ou des directeurs
• Veiller à ce que tous les permis de travail nécessaires soient demandés à temps et assurer la liaison avec les autorités compétentes
• Délivrance de confirmations d'emploi et d'autres certificats aux employés
• Émettre des lettres de référence provisoires et finales aux employés en fonction des commentaires des partenaires opérationnels des RH, des directeurs et des gestionnaires hiérarchiques
• Administrer toutes les données relatives aux employés dans les systèmes de RH pertinents et en assurer la précision et la qualité standard
• Gérer la numérisation et le dépôt de tous les documents RH pertinents dans le système de Dossier numérique (E-Archiving)
• Interface avec les partenaires/directeurs des RH, la paye et d'autres intervenants internes
• Administrer le système de gestion du temps et de l'absence et prendre des mesures en consultation avec l'employé ou le gestionnaire hiérarchique
• Construire et améliorer des relations / réseau à travers Idorsia à différents niveaux
• Participer ou diriger de petits projets dans l'ensemble de l'équipe des Services des RH
• Mettre constamment l'accent sur l'amélioration des activités de l'équipe des Services des RH et l'aider à réduire la complexité de tous les processus de RH connexes.
